verses.text: --Ex wetchonhab' yet' ex ichamtak winak, ab'ek in lolonel swal tik t'ayex, xchi winh.
Haxo ix yab'an heb' to ix lolon winh t'a ti' hebreo, te numan ix aj heb'. Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a heb':

--Ha in tik, israel in heyet'ok. Ha t'a chonhab' Tarso t'a yol yik Cilicia, hata' aljinak in, palta ha t'a Jerusalén tik k'ib'nak in. Haxo winhaj Gamaliel k'ayb'annak in. Ix in sk'ayb'ej wal winh sik'lab'il t'a sley heb' ko mam kicham. Swak'anpax wal serwil Dios t'a smasanil in k'ool, icha tzeyutej he b'a he masanil tiknaik.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo wixtejnak wal heb' ayoch t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al b'aj ay in och tiknaik. Ay b'aj in yamnakkot heb'. Wach'chom winak, ma ix, laj wak'nakoch heb' t'a preso. Ay b'aj wak'nakoch chamel t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh yajal smasanil syal yalan heb' winh to yel swala', yujto yak'nak juntzanh carta heb' winh t'ayin yik swik'anb'at t'a heb' ketisraelal t'a chonhab' Damasco. B'at in t'a chonhab' chi' yujto in gana tzin sayek' heb' creyente ta'. In gana sb'at in tzek'kot heb', tzul wak'an heb' t'a Jerusalén tik yik tz'ak'jioch syaelal heb'.

Palta haxo yik wan in b'eyi, ayik wanxo in k'och t'a slak'anil chonhab' Damasco chi', tekan chimk'ualil hama, ay jun sakil k'inal te ow yok kot kopnaj t'a satcha'anh, yemul t'a wib'anh, in kan t'a skal,
in telwi t'a sat lu'um yuj. Haxo wab'ani, yawaj jun t'ayin, yalan icha tik: Saulo, Saulo, ¿tas yuj tzin ixtej? xchi t'ayin.
¿Mach ach Mamin? xin chi t'ay. Ha in ton Jesús aj Nazaret in. Ha in wal tzin ixtej, xchi t'ayin.
Haxo heb' ajun wet' chi', yil jun sakil k'inal chi' heb', te xiw heb'. Palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' tas jun alji chi' t'ayin.
Slajwi chi' walan t'ay: Mamin, ¿tas a gana tzin k'ulej? xin chi t'ay. K'eanh waan. Ixik t'a chonhab' Damasco. Hata' ol aljok t'ayach tas yowalil ol a k'ulej, xchi Kajal Jesús chi' t'ayin.
Yujto majxo yal-laj wilan jab'ok yuj jun sakil k'inal chi', yuj chi' a heb' ajun wet'ok chi' ketzan in b'at t'a chonhab' Damasco chi'.
Haxo ta' ay jun winh skuch Ananías, sk'anab'ajej wal ley Moisés winh sik'lab'il. Te wach' syutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh heb' israel smasanil t'a chonhab' Damasco chi'.
k'och winh t'ayin, yalan winh: Wuk'tak Saulo, jakwokab' a sat, xchi winh. T'a jun rato chi', jakwixi in sat. Wilan winh.

Yalanxi winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha ko Diosal, haton jun Dios b'aj yak'nakem sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, ha' ix ach sik'aneli yik wach' ol ojtakejel tas snib'ej t'ayach. Yujto snib'ej to tzil Jesús, haton jun tojol spensar, ix ab'an pax tas ix yal t'ayach.
Xal tiknaik ol alel yab'ixal Jesús t'a skal anima smasanil. Ol ala' tas ix ila' yet' tas ix ab'i.
Haxo tiknaik manh a tanhwej. Ak' ak'jok bautizar a b'a. Al a b'a t'a Jesucristo yik wach' ol ak'jokkan lajwok a mul, xchi winh.
Haxo yik in jax t'a Jerusalén tik, in lesalwi t'a stemplo Dios tik. Ayik in lesalwi chi', ichato wayichan in.
Wilan Kajal Jesús, yalan t'ayin icha tik: Elanhchamel tzach el t'a Jerusalén tik, yujto toxon manh ol scha yab' jun wab'ixal heb' ol ala', xchi.
Yuj chi', wal t'ay: Mamin, toxon yojtak heb' to ix in ek' in say heb' ix yak'och sk'ol t'ayach t'a junjun spatil culto. Ix laj in yam heb', ix wak'anoch heb' t'a preso, ix in mak'an pax heb'.
Haxo winhaj Esteban, winh aljinakel ab'ixal, ayik smilannak cham winh heb', lokan in ta'. Ha in wilnakkan spichul heb' ayik sjulannakcham winh heb', xin chi t'ay.
Palta yalanxi t'ayin: Ixik, yujto najat tzach in chekb'ati, haton t'a skal heb' manh israelok. Icha chi' aj yalan Kajal Jesús chi', xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.

Ix smaklej yab' heb' anima chi' tas wan yalan winhaj Pablo chi', masanto t'a juntzanh ix yal winh chi', ix och ijan heb' ste awajk'ei, ix yalan heb': --Chamokab' winh. Manhxo smojok pitzan winh, xchi heb'.
Ix te k'e somnaj heb' skot yowal. Ix laj stzikub'tanhan spichul heb'. Ix stzipank'e lum pokok heb' t'a chaanh yik sch'oxanel heb' to te yowal heb' t'a winh.

Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winh coronel chi', ix yalan winh to tz'ik'jioch winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol cuartel chi'. Ix yalan winh to smak'ji winh yik wach' syal winh tas yuj sk'e yaw heb' anima chi' skot yowal yuj winh.

Haxo yik toxo ix tzek'ji winh chi' yik smak'ji winh, ix yalan winh t'a jun winh capitán ayek' ta' --¿Tom ay sleyal tzin he komon mak'ej? Ina aj Roma in. Hanhejtona', malaj jab'ok in mul ix cheklaji, xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winh capitán jun ix yal winh chi', ix b'at winh yal t'a winh coronel chi' icha tik: --Te ay smay jun wan a k'ulan tik. Ab'i to aj Roma winhaj Pablo chi', xchi winh t'a winh.
T'a jun rato chi' ix b'at winh coronel chi' sk'anb'ej t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --¿Tom yel aj Roma ach? xchi winh t'a winh. --I', aj Roma in, xchi winh t'a winh.
--Ichin pax ta'. Anhejto te niwan tumin ix wak'a', ix in manoch in b'a aj Romail, xchi winh. --Palta a in tik, atax yik ix in alji toxonton aj Roma in, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh.

Yuj chi', a heb' soldado ijan ix mak'an winh chi', ix yaktejxiel winh heb'. Ayik ix yab'an winh coronel chi' to aj Roma winhaj Pablo chi', ix te xiw winh, yujto ix yak' tzek'chaj winh yet' k'een cadena.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, snib'ej winh coronel chi' syab'i tas yuj ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi' yuj heb' israel. Yuj chi' ix schek winh ik'jokel k'een cadena chi' t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' masanil heb' winh sat yajal. Ix yik'anelta winhaj Pablo chi' winh t'a yol cuartel chi', ix ak'ji entregar winh yuj winh t'a heb' winh.
